IOHN.|257 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>{{hwe|per,|supper,}} and laieth aside his garments, and hauing taken a tovvel, girded him self. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=5}}† After that, he put vvater into a bason, and {{sup|‖}} began to vvash the feete of the disciples, and to vvipe them vvith the tovvel vvherevvith he vvas girded. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=6}}† He commeth therfore to Simon Peter. And Peter saith to him, Lord, doest thou vvash my feete? {{verse|chapter=13|verse=7}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered and said to him, That vvhich I doe, thou knovvest not novv, hereafter thou shalt knovv. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=8}}† Peter saith to him, Thou shalt not wash my feete for euer. {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered him, If I vvash thee not, thou shalt not haue part vvith me. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=9}}† Simon Peter saith to him, Lord, not only my feete, but also handes, and head. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=10}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} saith to him, He that is vvashed, nedeeth not but {{sup|‖}} to wash his feete, but is cleane vvholy. And you are cleane, but not al. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=11}}† For he knevv vvho he vvas that vvould betray him. therfore he said, You are not cleane al.

{{verse|chapter=13|verse=12}}† Therfore, after he had vvashed their feete, and taken his garments, being set dovvne, againe he said to them, Knovv you what I haue done to you? {{verse|chapter=13|verse=13}}† You cal me, Maister, and Lord: and you say vvel, for I am so. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=14}}† If then I haue washed your feete, Lord and Maister, {{sup|‖}} you also ought to wash one an others feete. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=15}}† For I haue giuen you an example, that as I haue done to you, so you doe also.⊣ {{verse|chapter=13|verse=16}}† Amen, amen I say to you, a seruant is not greater then his lord, neither is an apostle greater then he that sent him. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=17}}† If you know these things, you shal be blessed if you doe them. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=18}}† I speake not of you al: I knovv vvhom I haue chosen. But that the scripture may be fulfilled, ''He that eateth bread vvith me, shal lift vp his heele against me''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 40, 10.''}} {{verse|chapter=13|verse=19}}† From this time I tel you, before it come to passe: that vvhen it shal come to passe, you may beleeue, that I am he. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=20}}† Amen, amen, I say to you, he that receiueth any that I send, receiueth me: & he that receiueth me, receiueth him that sent me.

{{verse|chapter=13|verse=21}}† When {{sc|Iesvs}} had said these things, he vvas troubled in spirit: and he protested, and said: {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mat. 26, 18. Mar. 14, 16. Luc. 22, 21.''}}* Amen, amen I say to you: that one of you shal betray me. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=22}}† The disciples therfore looked one vpon an other, doubting of whom he spake. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=23}}† There vvas therfore one of his disciples leaning in the bosome of {{sc|Iesvs}}, he whom {{sc|Iesvs}} loued. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=24}}† Therfore Simon Peter beckeneth to him, and said to him, who is it of whom he speaketh? {{verse|chapter=13|verse=25}}† He therfore leaning vpon the breast of {{sc|Iesvs}}, saith to him, Lord, vvho is he? {{verse|chapter=13|verse=26}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered: He it is<noinclude>{{rh||Kk|to}}</noinclude>
